about: Every model the rig has tested, with its archive GGUF, status, scheduling placement, and named profiles. The only place model settings are edited. models.catalog.json, model_tuning_profiles.json and custom_tasks/model_prompt_profiles.json are generated from this file by scripts/active/model_library.py.

orchestration_defaults._notes: single/split: llama launch fallbacks when a model has no orchestration profile. max_tokens: generation cap per worker request.

default.notes: Worker-tier (1060 6GB). Microsoft Phi-4-mini-reasoning 3.8B dense. Q4_K_M (2.49GB). MIT license. Structural <think> tokens (same as DeepSeek-R1): --reasoning-budget 0 has no effect, runtime shows thinking=0. BENCHMARK: use --patch-think-tag-strip for bench-reasoning. bench-code INCOMPATIBLE (evalplus strips think+code together). bench-reasoning BBH/DROP FAIL on 1060 (runtime OOM from long prompts + think chains at 3g limit). bench-pipeline: json_schema 0% (think tags in JSON). Memory: needs 3g/4g Docker limits (2g causes OOM). Only GSM8K viable on 1060.
